# 1 Enoch Chapter 36 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Watchers

---

**1** From there I headed south to the ends of the earth. I saw three open portals in the sky there, and through them come dew, rain, and wind.

**2** Then I went east to the ends of the heavens, where I saw three more open portals on the eastern side of the sky, with smaller portals set above them.

**3** Through each of those smaller portals the stars of heaven pass through and make their journey west along the paths that have been laid out for them.

**4** Every time I witnessed all these things, I praised the Lord of Glory. I kept on blessing the Lord of Glory — who has done such great and wondrous deeds — because he chose to show the greatness of his work to both angels and human beings, so that they would worship what he has made and all his creation, so that they would see his mighty power at work and celebrate the great deeds of his hands and bless him forever.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Chapter 36 concludes the Book of Watchers with a vision of the southern and eastern portals (vv. 1-3) and a soaring doxology (v. 4). The final blessing — that God reveals his works so all creation can praise him — is the theological heart of the entire Book of Watchers. The repeated "so that" structure of the doxology is preserved and rendered with cumulative force.*
